DisposableStack.description:
ES2027 (Explicit Resource Management — reached Stage 4 in 2026-05, targeted at edition 17+1; already shipping in V8/Node/TypeScript ahead of the formal spec date)
DisposableStack collects multiple disposable resources (via `.use()`) and ad-hoc cleanup callbacks (via `.defer()`), then disposes them all, in reverse order, when the stack itself is disposed.
